mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which increases nalmefene's risk of cardiac arrhythmias and CNS effects; nalmefene may precipitate acute withdrawal syndrome in opioid-dependent patients potentially causing hemodynamic instability that worsens diuretic-induced electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium and sodium) closely; assess opioid dependency status before nalmefene initiation; monitor heart rate and ECG; consider alternative diuretic if possible or increase dietary potassium supplementation.
